# `aitbc agent status`

Get the current status and health of a specified agent.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | no | The Agent id. |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL (default: config agent_coordinator_url) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent status
```
